rollbackStrategy.renderer: Keep the previous package artifact and renderer configuration; disable the candidate feature or deploy the previous version.
rollbackStrategy.incrementalRendering: Disable incremental updates per session and perform a full render when dependencies or patch state are uncertain.
rollbackStrategy.accelerators: Set backend to javascript; do not require WebAssembly SIMD, SharedArrayBuffer or WebGPU for core rendering.
rollbackStrategy.responseCache: Disable or clear response cache and serve freshly rendered HTML if keys or invalidation are uncertain.
rollbackStrategy.aiTooling: Disable write/publish capabilities independently; retain the deterministic parser/validator and manual release path.

note: This manifest defines rollback procedures; deployment automation must implement and verify them in the target hosting environment.
